title: dum craft
description: some new biomes a new forest and a city and also adds new wepons plus two new dimensions. this mod will eventually have new updates to.
body: so there is a new forest biome that consists of flesh and veins and a biome that is a city and a stores. also there is space that you get to by makeing a portal out of iron blocks and a food dimension that has a cheese biome a cooked meat biome and a brocolli forest biome with vegible monsters.also there are two bosses the kraken and a eyeball man.there are new hostile and passive mobs like the robot(passive),space ship(hostile),radioactive zombie(hostile) and kevin the cat(passive).this mod will update time to time.it also has wepons like a baton a cheese sword and a few more.this mod also adds new toolslike the cheezite shovel and scale pick.
